column1: # C99 Annex D universal character names for identifiers (ISO/IEC 9899:1999 D.1 letters/special, D.2 digits). hex, inclusive.
# kind=letter: permitted in any identifier position. kind=digit (D.2): permitted only after the first character (6.4.2.1p3);
# D.2 ranges may overlap D.1 ranges in the standard (thai/lao/tibetan): membership in a digit range forbids the INITIAL position regardless of D.1.
# Outside the union of letter and digit ranges: refused in identifiers (6.4.2.1p3); independently refused by 6.4.3p2: < 00A0 except 0024 0040 0060, D800-DFFF, > 10FFFF.
# Source: https://www.open-std.org/jtc1/sc22/wg14/www/docs/n1256.pdf Annex D, printed pages 440-441 (PDF pages 451-452).
